Hi Hannah —

We signed off on the renewal and the capacity add yesterday. Attached is the PO (BlueArc_PO_9342.pdf). Two quick asks from finance before we route for signature:

1) We need invoices to go to our EU subsidiary (BlueArc EU Ltd) going forward — billing contact is billing@bluearc.com.
2) Can Redwood support Net45 for this renewal instead of Net30? That would help our treasury cycle.

I’ve also attached our VAT certificate and our EU company registration for tax evidence. If you need a W-8 or other US tax form, let me know and I’ll pull from the legal team.

Also, note we plan to increase the committed capacity by +20% starting Sep 1st (details in the PO). Want to ensure the billing owner and invoicing entity match that change.

Thanks —

Hi all —

Thanks, Amy. Quick finance note: we can approve Net45 for this renewal on a one-off basis, subject to receipt of valid tax evidence and the signed PO. For EU entities we typically require either:

• VAT registration (EU VAT ID) OR
• W-8BEN-E if invoicing to a US tax entity (not the case for BlueArc EU Ltd)

From the PO and the VAT document you sent, I need the following to complete the routing and payment terms change:
1) Confirm exact legal entity name for the invoice (as it appears on the VAT document).
2) Attach the VAT registration number in text OR provide the VAT cert as a single file (we prefer PDF).
3) A statement confirming the billing email to use for invoicing (you already listed billing@bluearc.com — I’ll use that once confirmed).

Operational items: once we have those, we’ll update the invoicing entity and set Net45 for the next billing cycle. DocuSign/contract amendment: because there is a term (payment) change and a capacity increase, legal will issue a short amendment that we’ll send via DocuSign. I’ve included the PowerForm link for BlueArc to sign quickly: https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=abc-123-def

Jordan — can you hold any invoice runs for the Aug 31st cycle until we confirm the entity change? If BlueArc needs a pro forma invoice for internal approval, we can generate one once the billing contact is updated.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Revenue Ops, Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai
